test_action_headers: test that Action.set_header and Action.get_header correctly store and retrieve headers with optional decode
test_action_message_headers: test that ActionMessage inherits headers from its parent Action via get_action_message
test_wire_message_headers: test that WireMessage.set_header and WireMessage.get_header store and retrieve binary and string headers
create_action_schema: create an ActionSchema with name, inputs, outputs, and description for an echo action
run_action_header_tests: run pytest async tests to verify header operations on Action, ActionMessage, and WireMessage objects
